definitions.explanation: Refers to the current time or moment.
Can indicate something that just happened or is about to happen.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: I'm coming now. / I'll be right there.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。

examples.english: Do you like your current job?

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Please come right away. Something terrible happened.

notes:
{今|いま} is one of the most common time words in Japanese. It functions as both a noun ({今|いま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ = current job) and an adverb ({今|いま}⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧ = I'm going now).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今|いま}⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧: right now, immediately
- {今|いま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from now, starting now
- {今|いま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: for now, at present
- {今|いま}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until now, so far

COMPOUND WORDS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧: today
- ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧: this week
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
- ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧: this morning
- ⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧: tonight

USAGE NOTE:
{今|いま}⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧ is a common response when called, meaning 'I'll be right there' (not literally 'I'm going now').
